state.deck_catalog is the output of --catalog, run by the interpreter .venv.streamdeck/bin/python of the checkout, read at start and again when the commit of the checkout changes, cut at TIMEOUT_S like the other reads; it is left out when the program does not answer
catalogArgv and readCatalog of erplibre-home-gnome-extension:lib/inventory-service.js, cancellable; catalogFrom of lib/deck-config.js keeps a catalog the extension can check.

Before it writes, the extension checks each layout against the catalog its checkout printed and the rules of format 1; a layout outside them, an action the catalog lacks included, refuses the whole revision with invalid:key_layouts

validateKeyLayouts of erplibre-home-gnome-extension:lib/deck-config.js, run by _layoutsRefused of lib/inventory-service.js when a reply of the pilot comes (_onConfig) and again at the click (_applyOffer).

The application writes keymap.json atomically, mode 0644, with streamdeck.conf or not at all, keeps the layouts of the models Odoo does not send, and restarts the deck service once, as in lot 3a; a file that already holds its values is not rewritten

_applyOffer of erplibre-home-gnome-extension:lib/inventory-service.js, keymapText of lib/deck-config.js merging per model; a keymap.json that exists but cannot be read is refused write_failed before any write.
